spec_match.rationale: A genuine terminal-operation use case: helpers compose over a lazy line generator and the native join finishes it, with pull-count evidence.

interactive.rationale: Textarea, level checkboxes, shape/limit/separator controls all re-run the pipeline live; the pipeline source rendering updates to match.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the paste-logs-get-a-block shape and the page is exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Nothing-matched worst case explained (filter still pulls everything), limit-cut vs full-read cases distinguished in the detail.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the feature suite (7/7 native pass).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Edits to levels/limit changed kept/pulled counts live; console clean; both viewports clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: log-formatted asserts the literal true; kept<=pulled would be a real invariant.

design_system.rationale: Fieldset/legend for the level checks, variables throughout.

accessibility.rationale: Checkboxes labelled individually inside a legend, textarea labelled, aria-live detail.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 full-page screenshots captured and inspected. Practical, honest, and running natively on this build.
